predictions.prediction_text: A settlement of VIX below 16.73 will trigger some mild buyback flows on ES futures as hedges unwind.
predictions.expected_result: Short-term net buying pressure in ES futures leading to a measurable uptick in ES price within the next 1 trading day after settlement

predictions.prediction_text: Accumulation of short call gamma into March Opex creates a 'time bomb' that increases the odds of spot up/vol up moves being realized soon if volatility is realized.
predictions.condition: Realization of volatility (an uptick in realized vol) into March Opex
predictions.expected_result: Rapid increase in VIX and option-implied volatility around March Opex and concurrent upward moves in underlying equity indices, producing losses for short call-gamma positions

predictions.prediction_text: 6100 is a strong support and a strong pin where zero vanna oscillates near, suggesting price will tend to gravitate toward or be held at this level intraday.
predictions.expected_result: Price will test and hold near 6100, showing intraday rejection of moves below that level and repeated price pinning within a narrow range around 6100

predictions.prediction_text: 6126 is the local upside zero vanna and low volatility is needed for price to break above this level, though a break is possible.
predictions.expected_result: If realized volatility remains low, price will break above 6126 within the intraday session; if vol increases, the break is less likely
